letter: My dearest Liza, my jaan, every sunrise in Dubai or a quiet Ahmedabad evening reminds me how lucky I am to share this beautiful life with you. Your laughter is my favorite soundtrack, and your smile lights up even the hottest desert nights. As spring whispers through the palms, I find myself falling deeper in love with my cutie, dreaming of all the adventures we’ve yet to explore together. Thank you for being my forever home, wherever we are.
poem:
In desert dunes or by the river’s sigh,  
Your love’s the breeze that lifts me high.  
Through seasons’ change, our hearts align,  
Forever yours, forever mine.
